_readme: Every piece the music showcase tenant publishes, and what it says about each one.
Adding a piece is: drop the file next to this manifest and add a row. No code
changes, no migration. `file` is relative to backend/seed-assets/.
CATEGORIES ARE DERIVED, NOT DECLARED. `categories` below is a dictionary of
available drawers; only the ones some PUBLISHED work actually files itself
under are created on the tenant. A filter button that opens onto nothing is
worse than no filter button, and the only way to guarantee that never
happens is to refuse to create the drawer before the work exists.
`early-years` is here and unused on purpose: the Saturday morning group is
real, it is on the timetable, and nobody has ever recorded it. The drawer is
the shape of the curriculum waiting for a recording.
`state` is active / draft / archived — the tenant keeps every piece at every
state, and the plan decides only how many of the active ones get published.
`rank` orders the six featured pieces; the home preview lays three in the
golden block and the rest beneath it, and the archive page shares that one
ordering.
STUDIO WORK IS THE TEACHERS AND THE ENSEMBLE. STUDENT WORK IS THE STUDENTS.
That split is not editorial, it is the consent model: `showcase_items` has
no consent gate and `portfolio_items` has two, so a student's own playing is
never on the studio board — not published, not drafted, not archived. The
board answers 'how good is the person teaching me'; the gallery answers
'what could my child sound like in three years'. `student` is an index into
the content module's STUDENTS, so the credit on the public page and the
record in the CMS name the same person.
WHY FOUR PIECES CHANGED HANDS. The repertoire draft credited eight of the
twelve to students, four of them at levels nobody on the roster holds: AMEB
Piano Grade 8, AMEB Piano Grade 7 and two works off the VCE prescribed list.
The roster is what the CMS is seeded from and it tops out at AMEB Piano
Grade 5 and Year 10. Restating an AMEB or VCAA listing as a grade it is not
would put a false fact on the one page a parent reads closely, so those four
went to the people who can actually play them — the principal, the strings
teacher, the voice teacher. Every syllabus fact here is still the syllabus's.
ONLY TWO OF THE FOUR STAFF MAY BE NAMED IN PUBLIC. ROLE_ACCOUNTS has Vivian
and Hannah consenting to appear publicly and the studio manager and the
Chinese-instruments teacher not consenting — the same two-of-four ratio the
timetable demonstrates. So the erhu tile and the voice tile say 'our
Chinese-instruments teacher' and 'our voice teacher' and stop there. Putting
the names back would contradict the switch this seed exists to show.
`consent` is confirmed (default) or withdrawn, and it is a STUDENT-level
fact, separate from the per-work `shared` flag. Both gates must be open for
a piece to appear publicly. One entry is withdrawn on purpose: a demo where
consent has only ever been granted proves nothing about what happens when it
is taken back. The withdrawn one is a child, and it has to be — the seeder
records a withdrawal as coming from a Parent, so an adult's tile would make
the console read like nonsense.
Sophie's tile is the second consent beat and it is not a withdrawal: she
agreed to the photograph and not to a recording. She is an adult and
consents for herself, which is why hers is the tile that says so out loud.
NO PIECE ON A CHINESE INSTRUMENT CLAIMS A GRADE. AMEB does not examine
guzheng, erhu or pipa at all, and the Chinese conservatory syllabuses
disagree with each other, so those tiles name the piece and stop. Every AMEB
attribution here is from the current syllabus (Piano Series 18, Violin
Series 10, Singing Series 2), and the VCE prescribed list is named as a list
a teacher plays from, never as a student's enrolment.
CAPTIONS DATE BY OCCASION, NOT BY YEAR. This tenant resets nightly and lives
for years; '2024' on a tile ages in public where anyone can see it, 'the
Term 3 concert' does not. The single exception is 'last year's end-of-year
concert' on the archived tile, where being old IS the point. Concert venues
stay unnamed for the same reason the people are invented.
THERE IS NO VIDEO FIELD AND THESE ARE PERFORMANCES. `_seed_studio_works`
hard-codes video_provider and video_id to empty, so every tile is a still
image — and the captions are written for a board of still images, which is
why two of them say in plain words why there is no recording rather than
leaving a visitor hunting for a play button. If a `video` key is added
later, parse_video_url() in studiosaas/video_embed.py accepts YouTube,
Vimeo and Bilibili and nothing else; until then, do not write 'listen' or
'watch' into a caption.
NO TILE IS A PHOTOGRAPH OF A CHILD. The twelve covers are abstract
instrument studies at 1600px WebP — bridges, bows, keys, a chair by a
window. A demonstration tenant that publishes pictures of minors, even
invented ones, is demonstrating the wrong thing, and a school full of
children is the last place to be casual about it.
SIX ROOM PHOTOGRAPHS, FIVE TEACHING SPACES. The timetable knows four rooms
(琴房一, 琴房二, 古筝房, 排练厅) because those are the four that classes are
booked into. The grand piano is in a fifth, 大琴房, which holds exam
run-throughs and concert rehearsals — booked, not timetabled. If the about
copy ever says 'four rooms' it is counting the timetable, not the photos.
The ensemble is 少年合奏团 / the Youth Ensemble here, which is what the course
catalogue calls it. An earlier draft called it 知音合奏团 / the Zhiyin
Ensemble; two names for one group on one website is one too many.
`logo.dark` is carried and never uploaded — the seeder takes the light
wordmark only. It is here so the reverse lockup travels with the pack
instead of being regenerated by whoever needs it next.

title.zh: 《茉莉花》（江苏民歌，本校合奏改编）
title.en: Jasmine Flower (Jiangsu folk song, arranged for the ensemble here)

caption.zh: 少年合奏团，十二月的社区音乐会。古筝、二胡、小提琴与钢琴，同一句旋律轮流交给不同的乐器。排了整整一个学期。
caption.en: The Youth Ensemble at the December community concert. Guzheng, erhu, violin and piano hand the same line to each other in turn. A full term of rehearsal.

title.zh: 《Waltzing Matilda》（帕特森词；本校中西合奏改编）
title.en: Waltzing Matilda (words by A. B. Paterson; arranged here for Chinese and Western instruments)

caption.zh: 少年合奏团，社区花园音乐会。二胡拉旋律，古筝当吉他用，钢琴只在副歌进来。台下有人跟着唱。
caption.en: The Youth Ensemble at the community garden concert. Erhu on the tune, guzheng standing in for a guitar, piano only in the chorus. People in the audience sang along.

caption.zh: 民乐老师，社区春节音乐会。当天的录像是主办方录的，不是我们的，所以这里只放照片。
caption.en: Played by our Chinese-instruments teacher at the community Lunar New Year concert. The recording that day was the organiser's, not ours, so all we publish is the photograph.

title.zh: 《Prelude for a Pensive Pupil》佩吉·格兰维尔-希克斯
title.en: Prelude for a Pensive Pupil, Peggy Glanville-Hicks

caption.zh: Vivian 独奏，十二月的社区音乐会。澳大利亚作曲家写的，整场里最安静的一首——排在合奏后面，好让厅里先静下来。
caption.en: Vivian, solo, at the December community concert. An Australian composer, and the quietest thing on the programme — put after the ensemble so the hall had somewhere to settle.

title.zh: 《White Cockatoo Spirit Dance》罗斯·爱德华兹
title.en: White Cockatoo Spirit Dance, Ross Edwards

caption.zh: Hannah 小提琴独奏，十二月的社区音乐会。这首在 VCE 指定曲目里，学生每年都问；她干脆自己先拉一遍给他们听。
caption.en: Hannah, solo violin, at the December community concert. It sits on the VCE prescribed list and students ask about it every year, so she played it to them first.

title.zh: 《Au bord de l'eau》加布里埃尔·福雷
title.en: Au bord de l'eau, Gabriel Fauré

caption.zh: 声乐老师演唱，学期末的小型演唱会，Vivian 钢琴。法语的歌先当诗慢慢念一遍再唱——她教学生也是这么教的。
caption.en: Sung by our voice teacher at the end-of-term singing afternoon, with Vivian at the piano. She speaks a French song slowly as a poem before singing it, which is also how she teaches it.

title.zh: 《三部创意曲第十五首》J.S. 巴赫（在练）
title.en: Sinfonia No. 15, J. S. Bach (in preparation)

caption.zh: Vivian 在练，打算放进十二月的节目单。三个声部还没分匀，先不放到网站上。
caption.en: Vivian has this under her hands for the December programme. The three voices are not even yet, so it stays off the site for now.

title.en: Battling the Typhoon, guzheng solo (Wang Changyuan)

caption.zh: Vivian，去年的年终音乐会。今年的节目单换掉了，记录留着。
caption.en: Vivian at last year's end-of-year concert. It came off this year's programme; the record stays.

title.zh: 《渔舟唱晚》古筝独奏（古曲，娄树华传谱）
title.en: Fishermen's Song at Dusk, guzheng solo (traditional, after Lou Shuhua)

caption.zh: Isabella，学了四年，第三学期汇报音乐会。摇指那一段练了六周，这次一次也没停。
caption.en: Isabella, four years in, at the Term 3 student concert. Six weeks on the tremolo passage, and this time she did not stop once.

title.en: Prelude in C, J. S. Bach (BWV 846)

caption.zh: Rachel，成人学员，来了一年多，第三学期汇报音乐会。踏板还是慢半拍，但整首第一次从头连到了尾。
caption.en: Rachel, an adult student a year and a bit in, at the Term 3 concert. The pedal is still half a beat late, and it still went end to end for the first time.

title.zh: 《Lime Juice Tub》澳大利亚民歌（AMEB 声乐第二套·三级）
title.en: Lime Juice Tub, Australian folk song (AMEB Singing Series 2, Grade 3)

caption.zh: Sophie，成人学员，学期末的小型演唱会。她同意放照片、不同意放录音——这条我们就照办。
caption.en: Sophie, an adult student, at the end-of-term singing afternoon. She agreed to the photograph and not to a recording, and that is where it stops.

title.zh: 《Siciliano and Allegro assai》库赫勒（AMEB 小提琴第十套·三级）
title.en: Siciliano and Allegro assai, Küchler (AMEB Violin Series 10, Grade 3)

caption.zh: Oliver，十岁，第三学期汇报音乐会，Vivian 钢琴伴奏。第一次和钢琴合：前八小节是数着拍子上去的，后面就开始听着走了。家长后来撤回了公开同意——这一张留在后台，不在网站上。
caption.en: Oliver, aged 10, at the Term 3 concert with Vivian at the piano — his first time with an accompanist. He counted the first eight bars, then started listening instead. His family withdrew consent afterwards, so this one stays in the console and off the site.

alt.zh: 大琴房：一台三角钢琴，考级前走台和十二月音乐会的合排都在这里
alt.en: The big room: the grand piano, where exam run-throughs and rehearsals for the December concert happen

alt.zh: 琴房一：一台立式钢琴和两个谱架，一对一的钢琴课与小提琴课在这间
alt.en: Practice Room 1: an upright and two stands, for the one-on-one piano and violin lessons

alt.zh: 古筝房：五台古筝，一对一和民乐小组用
alt.en: The Guzheng Room: five instruments, for one-on-ones and the Chinese-instruments group

alt.zh: 椅子和谱架摆好，等周六下午的乐团；乐理课也用这些位子
alt.en: Chairs and stands set out for Saturday afternoon's ensemble; the theory class uses the same seats

alt.zh: 琴房二：地垫、打击乐器箱和一台电钢琴，四到六岁的启蒙小组在这上课
alt.en: Practice Room 2: floor mats, a percussion box and a digital piano, where the four-to-six group meets

alt.zh: 前厅：两张沙发，家长可以坐着等；每节课最后十分钟想进来听，随时都可以
alt.en: The front room: two sofas for waiting parents, who are welcome in for the last ten minutes of any lesson
